name: Fractions
description: A fraction is one number, made of equal parts of a whole somebody named — and every way of using one follows from that.
author: Koda Math Lab
tagline: Equal parts, and what you can do with them.

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Speaks hints and says why the strip will not take an answer yet. Questions are never read aloud — this skill is for readers.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Plays a sound as a part is shaded and when an answer is checked.

features.name: Haptic vibration
features.description: Adds a small vibration to shading a part and to checking an answer.

features.name: Part labels
features.description: Writes what one part is worth under the picture, so the pieces name themselves.
